summary: Approved exact current commit d864132c54fb6a10d7456c2047ca4c2deffa56b5 with no unresolved blocking security finding. The prior evidence-integrity blocker is remediated: the response-local index counts IDs before building the resolvable map, excludes every duplicated ID from that map, and routes a selected duplicate to a programmatically focused Duplicate Evidence Target (Inert) alert without displaying either ambiguous record as citation detail. Duplicate table rows are visibly labeled inert, and Return restores focus to the exact invoking reference. Committed unit/browser regressions and an independent desktop/mobile harness exercise all duplicate-row and cross-reference controls, confirm neither conflicting summary resolves, preserve accessible focus return, and report no axe violation; this review independently reran the five focused component cases successfully. The remediation changes only the evidence explorer and its tests. Previously approved boundaries remain unchanged: network input begins as unknown and guarded nested data; all API/FHIR/model strings render through inert React interpolation; the browser makes only the fixed relative bodyless POST through the loopback Vite proxy; Vite filesystem isolation, local binding, credential/configuration exclusion, credential-free real-proxy process, no committed LD_LIBRARY_PATH mutation, memory-only state, no persistence/analytics/uploads/downloads/service worker/secondary network surface, local synthetic/no-real-PHI claims, Node 24/npm lock/toolchain integrity, and zero-vulnerability npm audit remain intact. Backend, dataset, requirements, OpenAPI, deterministic rules, and the zero-or-one-call/no-tools Gemini boundary are unchanged from main. Commit-bound verification passed at a137f4eaff360af6405f94b64a2d3543ed27869c; current HEAD differs from it only by the refreshed verification report, so the evidence is current for this review.
